## F15.background-tasks — Background tasks

Definition: Commands or agents that keep running while you work. (lever class: parallelism)
- claude-code [supported, verified] A session dispatched from agent view keeps running after you close agent view. AgentDefinition.background runs an agent as a non-blocking background task, and stop_task(task_id) stops a running background task. Task messages report background tasks such as backgrounded commands and subagents. | ev: E-claude-code-01587, E-claude-code-00832, E-claude-code-00904, E-claude-code-00518
- codex-cli [partial, verified] Background terminals are listed when unified_exec is in use. background_terminal_max_timeout sets the maximum empty write_stdin poll window (default 5m). The app-server method thread/backgroundTerminals/clean stops all running background terminals for a thread (experimental). Each cloud task has its own workspace and can keep working while your computer is asleep. | limit: Background terminals appear when `unified_exec` is in use; otherwise, the list may be empty. | ev: E-codex-cli-01221, E-codex-cli-00927, E-codex-cli-00219, E-codex-cli-02852
- copilot-cli [supported, verified] /tasks lists background tasks for the current session, including /fleet subagent subtasks. ## F15.scheduled-routines — Scheduled routines

Definition: Recurring or one-off scheduled runs.
- claude-code [supported, unverified] Claude Code offers three ways to schedule recurring or one-off work. A routine runs a session on a schedule in the cloud, not in parallel on your machine. Desktop scheduled tasks run Claude automatically on a recurring basis. /loop runs a prompt repeatedly while the session stays open; omit the interval and Claude self-paces between iterations. | ev: E-claude-code-07665, E-claude-code-01967, E-claude-code-07660, E-claude-code-07272
- codex-cli [supported, verified] Scheduled tasks run a prompt at a future time or on a recurring schedule, with their own settings and run history; recurring tasks run in the background. For Git repositories they can run on dedicated background worktrees; in non-version-controlled projects they run directly in the project directory. A setting can disable local scheduled tasks in the desktop app. | ev: E-codex-cli-00347, E-codex-cli-01666, E-codex-cli-01608, E-codex-cli-00871
- copilot-cli [supported, verified] `/every` schedules a prompt to run repeatedly and `/after` schedules a one-shot prompt to run once after a specified delay. Schedules can only be added from the prompt input using these commands with arguments; the schedule manager dialog is read-and-remove only. Automations run Copilot cloud agent on a schedule or in response to a repository event. | ev: E-copilot-cli-00595, E-copilot-cli-00925, E-copilot-cli-01511
- copilot-vscode [partial, verified] Automations run agent tasks from a saved prompt, session configuration, and schedule. A task can run on demand or be scheduled hourly, daily, or weekly. - cursor [supported, verified] Automations run cloud agents in the background on a schedule or in response to events. The built-in `/loop` skill runs a prompt or skill on a recurring or variable interval; if you don't specify a fixed interval, the agent chooses when to wake. | ev: E-cursor-02012, E-cursor-02138, E-cursor-01594, E-cursor-04059

## F15.cloud-agents — Cloud agents

## F15.delegation — Delegation to other agents

Definition: Handing work to another harness or agent product.
- claude-code [partial, verified] To involve a different tool, expose it to Claude as an MCP server. An advisor tool lets Claude decide mid-task when to consult a second model. - codex-cli [supported, verified] Subagents let Codex delegate focused work to specialized agents and bring their findings back into the main terminal session. From the terminal you can start a cloud task, or list recent cloud chats and check their status.
